QUOTE: `mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque(x)` is an empty `asm volatile ("" : [x] "+r" (x))`. The compiler must treat the value as unknown, so it cannot prove a condition constant and fold a branch.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names the primitive as the compiler-opacity barrier and puts the `mbedtls_ct_*` layer in `library/constant_time_impl.h`, so location and mechanism are both stated.
